summary:
We developed an educational video game called Colony Mars, a simulator of exploration and survival on Mars. The project consists of controlling a robot that must travel through different regions of the planet, discover places of scientific interest, and collect data to send back to Earth.

The game addresses real challenges of space exploration, such as energy management, dust storms, extremely low temperatures, and equipment wear and tear. It also allows players to repair the robot, manufacture spare parts using Martian resources, and upgrade its systems to continue the mission.

This project is important because it helps people understand the difficulties of exploring other planets and demonstrates how science, technology, and engineering can work together to solve problems. In addition, it aims to inspire interest in astronomy, robotics, and space research, specifically targeting a community of young people between 12 and 17 years old.
details:
Colony Mars is an educational video game that allows players to explore Mars by controlling a robot. The player must travel through different areas of the planet, investigate locations of scientific interest, collect resources, and transmit information back to Earth. It offers an interactive experience in which players must manage the robot's energy, temperature, and mechanical condition to keep it functioning.

The expected impact is to encourage interest in space exploration, astronomy, robotics, and technology, while teaching some of the challenges faced by space missions.

Artificial intelligence tools and web programming technologies such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript were used to develop the project. Its creativity lies in combining scientific exploration with survival and resource management, inspired by real Mars missions. Gameplay, learning, system functionality, and the challenges of Martian exploration were all considered during development.
